description: This file defines the EditFileTool class, a specialized tool for editing files within a project. It includes methods for parsing parameters, executing file edits with diff visualization, handling partial updates, and tracking contributions. The class manages file reading, writing, diff generation, user approval, and error handling, tailored for a code editing environment.

classes.name: EditFileTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool to facilitate file editing with diff visualization, user approval, and contribution tracking.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters into structured EditFileParams.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the file editing operation, including reading, diffing, user approval, and saving changes.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial updates to the file, typically for UI interactions.
